verdict.rationale: Teams bot platform docs confirm bots can be created that receive messages/events and support streaming responses (message streaming, slash commands), and Bot Framework-style architecture is implied via Bolt-porting guide and bots initiating/participating in conversations, but the evidence pack never explicitly describes the underlying Bot Framework REST/webhook events API or a real-time gateway connection mechanism in detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Bot Framework Connector/Activity protocol or webhook endpoint mechanics, independent developer corroboration of real-time event delivery reliability.
